messages:
Emma W: Quick sanity check — our reranker MRR on the eval harness fell ~6% after switching to the PTQ-int8 candidate model this morning. FP16 baseline: MRR 0.412, PTQ-int8: 0.388. NDCG@10 also down ~0.02. Anyone have immediate hypotheses?

Rajesh P: Did we change tokenizers or preprocessing? Even small tokenization shifts can change candidate ordering.

Marta G: I ran a quick diff. The quantized artifact was packaged with SentencePiece v0.1.96 instead of v0.1.94 — new special token handling. Also the eval pipeline was accidentally using qmax=128 for queries while training used qmax=64. That mismatch alone can shuffle ranks.

Emma W: Yeah I noticed one config drift: eval config uses 'doc_format=plain_text' vs training 'doc_format=structured'. Here's the exact eval command I ran:
```bash
eval/run_rerank.py --model xsum-rr-ptq --candidates candidates.jsonl --qmax 128 --normalize false
```

Rajesh P: Can you rerun pinning the tokenizer to the trained artifact and set qmax=64? Also enable length-normalization — production uses length-aware scoring.

Marta G: Reran with tokenizer pinned + qmax=64. Results: PTQ-int8 MRR 0.407, FP16 0.413. Delta ~0.6% now. Enabling length-normalize pushed PTQ to 0.410. So most of the regression was tokenizer + qmax mismatch, not quantization itself.

Emma W: :thumbsup: Good catch. Remaining small gap could be sampling variance — let's run 3 seeds and run a pairwise test.

Rajesh P: Also confirm batching order and random seed in the eval harness. Deterministic batching reduces variance across runs.

Marta G: I pushed a tiny PR to the eval harness to pin tokenizer version and add a qmax sanity-check. CI will run 3 seeds overnight. PR: https://github.com/redwood/evals/pull/442

Eval Bot: ci-pipeline: tests queued for PR #442 (5 jobs).

ci-bot: deploy-bot: FYI canary for model xsum-rr-ptq started on staging. No traffic routing to prod until CI passes.

Emma W: Thanks all. Action items: (1) Wait for CI runs; (2) run pairwise bootstrap significance if CI still shows a gap; (3) add onboarding checklist item to pin tokenizer version and qmax. I'll file the checklist item.

Rajesh P: I'll prepare the pairwise bootstrap script and run it once CI completes. Assign to me if it lands.

Marta G: Assigning to Rajesh. Will close the loop once CI results are in.
